game_rules_from_player.relic_display_slots: 4 slots PER ELEMENT tab (tabs seen: Light, Dark, Wind, Water, Fire + 2 more). Resonance Level = lowest slot level in that element (currently 14 on Light).
game_rules_from_player.display_bonus: Elemental stats and effects of relics on display (slotted) get +20%.
game_rules_from_player.owned_relics: Every owned relic gives its flat stats whether displayed or not (collection-based).
game_rules_from_player.unslotted_level: Unslotted relics take the lowest slot level of their element.
game_rules_from_player.affinity: Per Prydwen beginner guide: Elemental Affinity improves damage of that element together with Mastery; each Affinity also slightly raises Physical Mastery. Aegis presumably defensive (unconfirmed).
game_rules_from_player.season: Relic slot levels above the season threshold reset at new season (guide: +10 older text / 10% of account-level threshold).

relic_scaling_observed.level_multiplier: element stat at +14 = 2.625x base at +0 for every rarity (Mythic 200->525, Legendary 120->315, Epic 80->210, Rare 40->105). Approx 1 + 0.116*level.
relic_scaling_observed.star_bonus: each awakened star adds about +10% to element stat (Legendary 315 -> 346 at 1 star; Rare 105 -> 115 -> 126).
relic_scaling_observed.display_bonus: +20% on displayed relic's element stat and effects
relic_scaling_observed.implication: +1 slot level on all 4 slots of an element raises every relic of that element by ~4.4% at level 14
